Seamless Game Installation

Follow these simple steps to get your games installed and ready to play with Jade Orchard.

How It Works

Step 1: Download

Download the Jade Orchard installer from our website. It's lightweight and quick!

Step 2: Install

Run the installer and choose your desired game. Our smart installer handles the rest.

Step 3: Play

Launch your game directly from Jade Orchard and dive into the action!

System Requirements

Minimum Requirements

  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 or equivalent
  • Storage: 50 GB available space

Recommended Requirements

  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 or equivalent
  • Storage: 100 GB available space

About Jade Orchard

Discover the story, mission, and team behind your favorite game installation platform.

Our Mission

Founded by passionate gamers, Jade Orchard was born out of a desire to simplify the often tedious process of installing and managing game libraries. We believe that gamers should spend less time waiting and more time playing.

Our mission is to provide a fast, reliable, and user-friendly platform that empowers gamers worldwide.

Core Values

Speed

Delivering the fastest download and installation speeds possible.

Reliability

Ensuring a stable and dependable experience every time.

Gamer-Centric

Designing features with the gamer's experience as the top priority.

Community

Building a supportive community for gamers around the world.
